summary: Connect Biopharma Holdings Ltd filed a Form 8-K on September 30, 2026, furnishing a press release and corporate presentation under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to announce topline results from its global Phase 2 study of rademikibart in acute COPD exacerbations. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial enrolled 159 participants with eosinophil counts ≥300 cells/µL, randomized 1:1 to a single subcutaneous dose of rademikibart or placebo plus standard of care. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations transaction is disclosed. The event is a routine clinical data update, not a special situation. Watch for stock reaction and potential partnering interest tied to the data.
